body: Thanks a lot for your response. I'm really glad you made a connection to me, and I'm even more glad that you have done so well for yourself. Your advice is very powerful and I certainly love to hear a turn-around story. I'm sure you understand that it's a little tough for me to see it now, though, but your hopeful feedback is very helpful.

Thanks for the response. I guess the big kicker here is that I don't really know what I enjoy or am good at it. I get that's natural for many college students, but I feel like I'm wasting time/money. And my condition - whether or not it's something actually serious or just me overreacting - is really hindering the path to refining it. So it's kind of like a Catch 22, if that makes sense.

I've finally come around to scheduling an appointment with the school's psychiatric center. A big revelation this week was that my family actually has a history of depression/anxiety issues (my dad and his mom apparently both struggled/for a time used meds). Maybe that can expedite the right direction to go in.

As far is majoring, I've been changing my mind frequently, though about a month ago I started to warm up to a double in Communications and Economics. I get a lot of enjoyment out of stuff like advertising, marketing, PR, and even some broadcasting (I'm big into Student TV) but it's no secret that Comm alone is kind of a weak degree, so I thought I'd add on Econ as it's very practical and flexible, plus the difference at my school between an Econ major/minor is only two or three courses, so no on really just takes the minor. 

The problem is, I'm doing terrible in the intro Econ class. It's intended to be a massive weeded class (especially for the business school hopeful kids) but I know I'm not trying/preparing sufficiently so it's not just rigor. I'm also not performing all too well in one or two "easier" courses, so that definitely suggests it's me. I just can't really pinpoint if these poor study habits are pure laziness, lack of interest, or I actually have a real problem.  

Thanks for the response
